basic_info.description: Location, Location, Location! Discover the enchanting allure of this charming 2-bedroom, 1-bath home that truly embodies character and charm. Ideally situated just a stone's throw away from the vibrant Cortland Street shopping and dining district, this gem offers both convenience and a lively neighborhood atmosphere.    Step inside to find a delightful formal dining room and a cozy living room, perfect for entertaining or relaxing. The bright kitchen, complete with an adjoining breakfast room, invites you to savor morning coffee or casual meals in a sunny setting. A functional mud/laundry room adds to the home's practicality.    Outside, a quaint private yard provides a serene retreat, while ample garage storage offers endless possibilities for your hobbies or projects. This home is brimming with potential, making it a perfect canvas for your personal touches!
